item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t make the requested 8-second scripted video with the current free-plan settings: text-to-speech presenter videos are limited to **5 seconds** unless a credit pack has been purchased. I won’t shorten your script or rush it into five seconds.

You can either:
- **Add a credit pack** to enable the 8-second scripted video.
- **Upload an 8-second recording** of the exact line in a friendly female English voice you’re authorized to use, and I can animate your photo to it.

The video would stay square, with no captions.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the free-settings attempt because your account has **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

You’ll need more credits before I can generate the 5-second square video with your exact script and no captions.

approvals.name: create_video_from_image

style.prompt: Animate this portrait into a square 1:1 talking portrait video, preserving the woman's likeness, clothing, park background and framing. She looks into the camera with a friendly expression, natural subtle movements and accurate lip sync. Generate a friendly female English speaking voice, a generic synthetic voice, not a clone of the depicted person's voice. She says exactly: "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new." Fit the entire line in five seconds with brisk clear delivery, beginning immediately. No additional spoken words. No captions, subtitles, on-screen text, music or logos.
